details.description: DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus is DeepSeek's September 22, 2025 update to DeepSeek-V3.1, per DeepSeek's own API changelog, targeting user-reported issues: mixed Chinese-English text and stray characters, plus further tuning of its Code Agent and Search Agent tool use. Per its Hugging Face model card it keeps V3.1's hybrid thinking/non-thinking Mixture-of-Experts architecture and MIT license. DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoint names have since moved on through DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and V3.2 to newer DeepSeek-V4 models.
advantages: Scores 85.0 on MMLU-Pro, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 80.7 on GPQA-Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 68.4 on SWE-bench Verified, up from 66.0 for DeepSeek-V3.1, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 96.8 on SimpleQA, up from 93.4 for DeepSeek-V3.1, per its Hugging Face model card.
Reduces mixed Chinese-English text and improves Code Agent and Search Agent performance over DeepSeek-V3.1, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: DeepSeek's own changelog shows the deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner endpoint names have since moved on to newer DeepSeek-V4 models, so this checkpoint is no longer served under those default aliases.
Superseded about a week later by the experimental DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and roughly ten weeks after that by DeepSeek-V3.2, per DeepSeek's own changelog.
Text only; no image or audio input or output.
use_cases: General-purpose chat with a switchable thinking/non-thinking mode.
Agentic coding and web-search tool use via its Code Agent and Search Agent.
Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation, per Fireworks AI's hosting page.

notes: Catalog's facts for this target (max_input_tokens 128000, max_output_tokens 8192) come from its single Fireworks listing, but Fireworks' own product page for this exact model states a 163,840-token context length, which conflicts with the catalog value; the catalog's figure is kept per instructions. This checkpoint's own Hugging Face model card does not restate a context-length figure, but DeepSeek-V3.1's own card (the shared base architecture) lists 128K, matching the catalog value; the 163,840 figure appears to be a Fireworks-specific serving limit rather than a maker-stated figure for this exact checkpoint. Total parameter count also differs by source: 685B on Fireworks' page vs 671B/37B-activated in DeepSeek-V3.1's own model card for the shared base architecture; no figure is stated in the description. No public GitHub repository specific to this checkpoint was found.
